body.question: Which three addresses sent the most IMD (token contract 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) to 0x4e0fa57bde726079356537e2f34d671e9f41adbc on Ethereum mainnet in the window? Rank senders by the sum of value over Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value) events of that contract whose to argument is 0x4e0fa57bde726079356537e2f34d671e9f41adbc, grouped by from; answer exactly the top 3 addresses, largest first, ties by ascending address.

definitions.inclusion: Include every canonical matching Transfer event, including zero-value transfers or any sender address. Ignore removed logs and deduplicate identical blockNumber/logIndex pairs only.
